Owned body lines 1670-1703 record the missing steps.

ED26-SRC-001-001-DEVELOPMENT (d): computable enumerability of T-sharp in the Turing-machine sense (owned body lines 2183-2194) rests on thm:p04-tm-partial-recursive.
